Isaac's Exciting Wahoo Fishing Adventure in San José del Cabo

Fishing Report Dec 4 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

An Exciting Day of Wahoo Fishing in San José del Cabo

December 2025 brought an unforgettable fishing experience for Isaac in the waters off San José del Cabo.

Joining Exotic Fish Cabo for a private fishing adventure departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, Isaac headed out to enjoy a day on the ocean and experience the excitement of sportfishing in Los Cabos.

What followed was a series of memorable encounters with one of the ocean's fastest predators.

The excitement began when the first wahoo appeared, signaling the start of an action-packed fishing experience.

Known for their incredible speed, powerful runs, and razor-sharp teeth, wahoo are among the most exciting game fish found in the waters around San José del Cabo.

When Isaac felt the first powerful strike on his line, the challenge began.

The fish fought hard, testing his patience and determination as he worked to bring it closer to the boat.

With assistance from the crew, Isaac successfully landed his catch.

But the adventure didn't end there.

Throughout the outing, Isaac encountered more wahoo, eventually landing several impressive fish during a series of exciting battles.

Each catch brought another memorable moment, demonstrating the speed and fighting ability that make wahoo fishing such a thrilling experience.

For Isaac, the day was about more than simply catching fish. It was an opportunity to enjoy the ocean, experience the challenge of sportfishing, and create memories worth sharing.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: December 2025

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Angler: Isaac

  • Species caught: Wahoo

  • Catch highlights: Several wahoo landed during the outing

  • Experience: Private fishing charter

Wahoo are prized for their exceptional speed, aggressive strikes, and distinctive silver-blue bodies marked with vertical stripes.

Their activity around San José del Cabo depends on changing ocean temperatures, currents, baitfish availability, and seasonal conditions.

Every fishing trip is different, and catches are never guaranteed.
